audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) read Skill and row 6 (2+ items) read Kennen, in both layers, while the prose on those rows says the opposite.
audit.why: whys[4]: 'His R AOE stun lasts far longer than your single-target Depth Charge can answer' — that is a Kennen row. whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say the 2-item window is when Nautilus finally kills him off a missed shuriken — that is a Nautilus row. The packet chart and the completed mirror audit both read Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Nautilus.
audit.corrected: Row 4 flipped to Kennen and row 6 to Nautilus as matched full+content pairs, phases[6].rating raised to 7/10, and both why strings rewritten to state the reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states how Mark of the Storm actually stuns, and it treats Lightning Rush as a vague 'escape' with no cooldown number. Itemization says nothing about Kennen's damage being on-hit magic applied through Electrical Surge.
audit.why: enemyKit P: 'Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities' — Q, W and E each apply one mark, so the actionable rule is to disengage at two marks, not to fear a generic 'triple stun'. enemyKit E cd is 10/9/8/7/6 and it passes through units, which is why the hook has to come out before he casts. enemyKit W carries the onHit flag and the missingInteractions file flags onhit-itemization: his damage scales with attack speed, so MR and tenacity, not armour, read the trade.
audit.corrected: Mark of the Storm's three-hit rule written into dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t; Lightning Rush's 10s rank-1 cooldown put into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; Electrical Surge named as on-hit magic in the itemization line.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Depth Charge cannot miss, but Slicing Maelstrom is a 120s AoE stun your single-target lockup cannot trade with — never fight a full-energy Kennen at 6.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kennen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: one missed Thundering Shuriken and your Q-pull chain kills him before he kites — force the side lane now.

edits.before: His escape. Hook before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and passes through units. Hook first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun — Q, W and E each add one. Leave at two.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. Hook before it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 — hook before he casts. Three marks stun you: break off at two.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (perma-slow chains), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Sunfire Aegis. Electrical Surge is on-hit magic: Mercury's Treads.

notes: spikes[2].text calls Slicing Maelstrom 'a 5-second AOE stun'. Riot's text gives no stun duration — the stun comes from Mark of the Storm stacking, and 5 seconds is not the stun length. I did not rewrite it because I cannot verify the correct figure from the kits; flagged as unverified rather than guessed. Whether Lightning Rush's unit-passthrough lets Kennen cross terrain is not answerable from the kits, so no claim made either way (the mirror reached the same conclusion).
